cancel_order.description: Cancel an unpaid order. Paid orders must be refunded instead.
cancel_order.name: cancel_order

order_id.description: The id (UUID) of the unpaid order to cancel.

create_ticket.description: Open a support ticket, optionally about one of the caller's orders.
create_ticket.name: create_ticket

body.description: What happened, in the customer's own words.

order_id.description: The order this is about, if any. Format: UUID.

subject.description: A short summary of the problem.

get_order.description: Look up one of the caller's orders by id.
get_order.name: get_order

order_id.description: The id (UUID) of the order, as returned by list_orders.

list_orders.description: List the caller's orders, newest first.
list_orders.name: list_orders

request_refund.description: Request a refund for one of the caller's orders. Policy decides: small refunds are paid immediately, larger or unusual ones wait for human approval.
request_refund.name: request_refund

amount.description: Amount to refund, in the order's currency. A decimal string such as "250.00", never a JSON number.

order_id.description: The id (UUID) of the order to refund.

reason_code.description: Why the customer wants a refund.

search_knowledge_base.description: Search the shop's help articles for policies and FAQs (shipping, returns, refunds, payments, warranty, support hours). Use it for questions about how the shop works. It returns excerpts to quote or summarise; it cannot change anything.
search_knowledge_base.name: search_knowledge_base

query.description: The customer's question about shop policies or FAQs, in plain words.
